name: Vigil

components.pose: She stands upright on a high stone gatehouse at first light, her weapon planted point-down before her with both hands resting on it, wings folded behind her, her gaze steady and calm toward the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: The first light of dawn lies along her wings and flowing water and drifting spray drift in the cold air around her, {{MAGIC}} light on the edge of her weapon.

notes: DUTY: Vigil, for her alignment (rank 2); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
